# Customer is an uncalibrated instrument

`customer_support.mm.root_cause_analysis.customer_is_an_uncalibrated_instrument` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **mental_model**

> The customer is an instrument you did not calibrate: sensitive, positioned exactly where the fault surfaced, and reporting in units of their own mental model.

This is the framing that makes their report simultaneously indispensable and untrustworthy, and stops the two common errors — dismissing the report because a detail is wrong, and taking the report literally because it is detailed.
